name: nami
description: Nami — AI agent workbench, by Dainami. Open a folder, run Claude Code and other agents as paper tiles.
author: Calvin Hia

scripts.//dist: predist matters: npm runs pre<name> for any script, so `pack` picked up the weights via prepack while `dist` — the one that builds what users install — quietly shipped without them.
scripts.//dist2: publish never is baked in, not passed: npm appends `-- args` to the end of the whole script string, so with a chained script the flag lands on fix-update-metadata and electron-builder tries to publish anyway. Uploading is a separate step so the update metadata can be corrected first.

//deps: transformers and onnxruntime-node are pinned exactly on purpose: a v3→v4 transformers bump swaps the tokenizer and the wasm-vendoring story, and onnxruntime-node's prebuilt-binary layout moves between napi generations. Re-pin deliberately, never by caret drift. Packaging lives in electron-builder.yml.
